headline: イラン・中東情勢、FRBが市場の主な焦点
executive_summary: 重要度Aのテーマは3件です。市場データは未取得または限定的です。投資判断ではなく、公開情報の整理として確認してください。

sections.title: イラン・中東情勢
sections.summary: イラン・中東情勢では、US – Israel – Iran War Day 52 : Strait of Hormuz explodes into chaos as US seizes Iranian cargo ship ; Tehran cries  piracy , Pakistan peace push hangs by a thread / Iranian nuclear sites turned to dust , claims Donald Trump as US - Iran talks hit limbo / As ceasefire ends tomorrow , a look back at key demands from US and Iran to end the war が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: FRB
sections.summary: FRBでは、Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement / Federal Reserve Board releases results from two surveys of senior financial officers at banks about their views on discount window operating days and their strategies and practices for managing reserve balances / Federal Reserve Board names Jerome H. Powell as chair pro tempore; Powell will serve as chair pro tempore until Kevin M. Warsh is sworn in as the new chair が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: 要人発言
sections.summary: 要人発言では、Bowman, When Regulation Reshapes Markets: The Migration of Corporate Lending / Barr, Brief Remarks on Stablecoins / Bowman, Supporting Small Businesses が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: その他
sections.summary: その他では、Merz :  İran yaptırımlarını kademeli olarak hafifletmeye hazırız   / Иран предлагает США открыть Ормузский пролив до решения ядерной программы – Reuters | Новости Украины / Глава МИД Франции отверг идею снятия санкций с Ирана без открытия Ормуза が主な確認材料です。
